[quote=gythena;60285408][b]Concerning Relations with Gythena and the WMW Company[/b]

The Gythenan Prime Minister, Gabriel Holder, has announced that the Gythenan government and WMW Company have come to an agreement. The following details of the trade deal have been released:

[i]Gythena will purchase 75 WMW-RODENT tanks to be shipped out into the harbor of Edilthorpe.[/i]

[i]Gythena will pay around 30,000,000 for the tanks, and an additional 10 million will be sent as charity for the WMW workers in Wolffland.[/i]

Gabriel Holder stated, We hope for positive relations and potential cooperation with the company going forward. We believed that WMW had what we were looking for and we hope that the shipment to Edilthorpe is successful.

[b]Accepting the Terms[/b]
As the Head of the Ministry of Labor reads over the costs and transactions, he shares it to other in his departments. The Tartakum Ministry of Labor approves the Qianxun list of costs, and sends over the dealing of the arms and information regarding Qianxun arms.

The Board of Arms looks, and decides to order a limited number of ZTZ-65 tanks, around 3, due to shortfalls in budgets. They will also be sending a Patrol Boat and a Missile cutter to protect the Qianxun ships in their waters. 

They Chief Diplomat goes ahead and orders building to commence on the Qianxun Embassy, to be near the Italian one. He sends over a request to the Qianxun Foreign department to build a Tartakum embassy also. He will be in touch for further news regarding the joint exercise, such and such. [nation]Qianxun[/nation]
